nesnd_tenasserim_recovery_reason: Dye shipments connect the southern plantations to the imperial market. Rent, advances and debt bind many village households to that trade. Tenasserim needs people to fell timber, haul cargo and run the port, and it needs rice fields that can still feed a family. Only when new hands are paid their wages and tenants keep their harvest will the interior have trade and savings of its own.
nesnd_tenasserim.1.d: Tenasserim's programme has hit trouble. The logging camps and workshops need employers willing to pay wages; villagers can keep their harvest only once tenancy and debt are sorted out; and the instructors sent by the authorities must be paid for year after year.
flavorCNE.6.d: Land commissioners in [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_mess_imprisonment_state').GetName] have arrested villagers who drafted petitions over disputed titles and placed them in military custody for concealing property. Officers widened the arrests to local gentry, teachers and clerks who kept the old deeds.\n\nThe new law empowers officials to settle land ownership, but also permits farmers to defend their property. The prisoners' families have taken their deeds to the provincial capital, and the governor has referred the case to the Ministry of Justice. The commissioners, warning of collusion between soldiers and villagers and of possible unrest, have asked the Ministry of War to protect the officers involved.
flavorCNE.8.d: The streets of [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_peasants_in_city_state').GetName] are filling with newcomers from the countryside. Farming families have sold their land and come in search of wages. Employment brokers send them to factories and building sites, deducting recruitment and lodging charges from their pay.\n\nWorkers have accused the brokers of withholding contracts and enforcing old debts. Manufacturers fear that an inquiry will hamper recruitment, while local gentry speak up for brokers linked to their own associations. The peasants have left the old estates behind, yet in town someone else still holds their contracts.
je_ce_polish_reconquest_reason: We must unite the Polish people, that's the justice not just for one nation but for all.
je_ce_polish_war_preparation_reason: We must prepare our military for the inevitable conflict.
nesnd_chen.1.d:
Chen Dongyang came to Southern Ming as an exile from Western Qin and joined King Zheng Qin of Wu in reforming the state. Guoren republicans thereby entered the heart of Southern government. Reform now threatens the estates and titles of gentry, former feudal lords and officers; hostile verses and threatening letters continue to arrive. Master Dongguan remains absorbed in public affairs, but the cabinet cannot entrust his safety entirely to old alliances.

Keeping the leader of reform alive will cost money, and the cabinet that commands his guards will gain a little more power by it.

ai_strategy_nesnd_cne_land_and_schools_d: This country plans to change land tenure and widen public education. How fast it goes depends on political support, administrative capacity and the legislative process.
nesnd_cne_land_journal_reason: The estates amassed by military nobles and local lineages have kept generations of farming families bound to their old masters. The new law lets land change hands, and gives merchant farmers room to expand. But a bill of sale cannot conjure up a new living for those who lose their land. The quarrels over converted estates, hired labour and resettlement will follow this change into every village.
nesnd_cne_urban_stop_button_desc: Suspend state resettlement and urban expansion, and withdraw this grant.
nesnd_cne_camps_journal_reason: Since 1444, the Qin military colonies of Northern Ming have developed into an estate system across the north. Land supplied the army's food and pay, while the army sustained taxation and conquest. Military and agricultural interests grew together. Bringing these lands and mines into civilian use now threatens entrenched military privileges.\n\nThe Ministry of Revenue wants every province to bring the estates under ordinary taxation and management; the Ministry of War, meanwhile, has to fend off generals demanding back pay and rewards for old service. It is the governors who must enforce the new law, yet they may not have the troops to overawe the garrisons. The founding commanders in the Senate will not lightly agree to be stripped of their own property either. In the end, the land the army loses must be made up by new revenue and new production.
nesnd_cne_funding.1.d: The governor of [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] reports that many people leaving the estates lack the skills needed by workshops and struggle to find a living in town. The Ministry of Revenue proposes a grant for practical schools and workshop expansion. Only when these villagers have learned a new trade will the freedom promised by land reform have something to stand on.
nesnd_crisis.21.d: Zheng fleets, trading houses and dependencies have carried news of the Southern war abroad. Merchants fear the seizure of their cargoes, while envoys from the rival sides seek recognition, military supplies and loans.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has its own calculations in all this. Keeping trade open means dealing with whoever actually holds the ports and sea lanes; sheltering exiles or supplying the anti-Wu forces would bind the South's old and new powers more tightly to us.
nesnd_crisis.40.d: The fighting is over, and local civil and military authority is passing to Wu one province after another. The question now is how to govern: production and trade broken by war must recover, the people of every province must go on living, and the officials and scholars who opposed the Zheng will not vanish with their defeat.\n\nThe army and treasury Hangzhou has built up over the years can pay for the rebuilding. From the first few decrees, the realm will learn what kind of court the Zheng mean to run in their own name.
nesnd_crisis.41.d: The troops are returning from abroad. Local lords demand the rewards promised when they joined the campaign, merchants want shipping restored, and the government must arrange its garrisons and revenues.\n\nThe mainland war has handed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] a chance to put its army and government in order.
nesnd_ottoman_unity_reason: Conquest has brought peoples of every faith, language and history into the Ottoman realm. Officials in Anatolia, local powers in the Balkans and newly incorporated peoples all expect Istanbul to protect their interests.\n\nSchools, government offices and a secure living can make the provinces accept the state; endless war and discrimination only drive people further away. Conquered lands are held only if the provinces are willing to cooperate.
nesnd_ottoman_unity_calm: The centre and the provinces still cooperate, but the peoples' attachment to the state is not yet firm.
nesnd_ottoman_recovery_reason: The Near Western War laid bare the faults of the old army. With Western Qin driven out of central China, officers in Istanbul urge an advance eastward to restore Ottoman standing in the Islamic world.\n\nWhatever the Tanzimat achieved, and whatever walls it ran into, will tell on this army. The money must be raised, and both the new territorial demands and the army's reform are waiting for it.
nesnd_western_provinces.1.a: The West has not been won over yet.
kazakhstan_events.3.d: The frontier garrisons have retaken the roads onto the steppe. How to govern the Kazakh districts now under Russia, and whether to press claims farther south along the caravan routes, are questions now before St Petersburg.
russian_central_asia.1.d: South of the steppe, the river roads connect the markets of Bukhara, Khiva and Fergana. Russian cavalry can ride those roads, but it cannot carry commerce past every customs post by force.
nesnd_unity_material_subsidy_desc: Pay subsidies to the poor and the discriminated against, so they will want to join in a common social life. Those who hold the old privileges will only see money taken from their own plates.
nesnd_unity_political_subsidy_desc: Give those long pushed to the margins of politics a voice in national affairs. The old foundations of power will be shaken, but a common national identity will have somewhere to take root.
je_manifest_destiny_mexico_reason: Dongzhou has long been established along the Pacific coast, and its support helped establish the Mexican republic. American expansionists still draw the western harbours, pastures and trade routes into the Union's future. If the republic is to stretch from the Atlantic to the Pacific, these lands must belong to the Union, however many talks and however many wars it takes with the western states.
je_manifest_destiny_frontier_wars_reason: Indigenous peoples and Mongol pastoralists travel the routes across the Great Plains, while Dongzhou's soldiers and merchants press farther inland. American settlers, land speculators and frontier officers all want these lands drawn into the Union.
